title: StatTile
description: One headline number with its label, change and optional trend line.

value.description: The figure, already formatted (currency, units, compact notation).

delta.description: Change as a fraction: 0.064 → +6.4%. Shown as a signed pill: good news with a trend arrow, bad news with an alert mark, no change with no mark.

deltaLabel.description: What the change is measured against, e.g. "vs last month".

positiveIsGood.description: Whether an increase is good news. false for costs, churn, wait times.

betterLabel.description: Read by screen readers after a change that is good news ("+6.4% better"). Translate it with the page.

worseLabel.description: Read by screen readers after a change that is bad news ("+3.1% worse"). Translate it with the page.

caption.description: A quiet line under the value, used instead of a delta.

icon.description: Decorative icon at the top inline-end.

sparkline.description: Recent values, oldest first (≥2 finite points). Decorative line with a 12% area fill and an end dot.

variant.description: Same chrome options as Card; ghost for tiles inside a card. editorial = a quiet inset figure for a card (a showcase card's results): the number first, large and regular weight, the label beneath, a hairline edge on a slightly lifted face (surface.canvas light, surface.default dark), no shadow; its corner follows the card's.

fallback.description: Rendered instead of this node by a client that doesn't know its type. Must be a node that client knows.

x-syntara-rule.message: A StatTile needs props.label and props.value as text: the figure means nothing without its label.
